Bug_Title: Assignment of lazy-initialized members should be the last step with double-checked locking
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the code by assigning the volatile field 'strings' before the initialization is complete within the synchronized block. This allows other threads to see a partially initialized object if they pass the first null check after another thread assigns 'strings'.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by running two threads which access the 'showBug' method simultaneously. Due to double-checked locking not being correctly implemented, there is a chance for a thread to access the 'strings' list before it is completely initialized, leading to an assertion failure when checking the contents of the list.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the test passed successfully without any errors, confirming that the bug was not triggered during the test execution.
